entries.subject: DAMIT 1811: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 1811, version 2017-06-16, pole (355°, 55°), period 6.189593 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 137 ± 3 km, volume-equivalent diameter of the archived ADAM model. DAMIT marks model 1811 as size-calibrated (D = 137 km, σ = 3 km), the volume-equivalent diameter of this ADAM solution. Hanuš et al. (2017) Table 4 lists 135 ± 3 km for the publication fit; the archived release is kept as archived. The fit used 9 light curves, 2 adaptive-optics images and 1 occultation (Table 3).
